options.name: hours
options.description: Length of maintenance window in hours.

options.name: minutes
options.description: Maintenance window in minutes (this is added to the hours).

options.name: name
options.description: PagerDuty unique subdomain. Obsolete. It is not used with PagerDuty REST v2 API.

options.name: requester_id
options.description: ID of user making the request. Only needed when creating a maintenance_window.

options.name: service
options.description: A comma separated list of PagerDuty service IDs.

options.name: state
options.description: Create a maintenance window or get a list of ongoing windows.

options.name: token
options.description: A pagerduty token, generated on the pagerduty site. It is used for authorization.

options.name: user
options.description: PagerDuty user ID. Obsolete. Please, use O(token) for authorization.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: window_id
options.description: ID of maintenance window. Only needed when absent a maintenance_window.
